page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top ("Roma Irreconciliabilis." with page number 175 at top right). One column of running text in the centre; a narrow blank column to its right. Below the text block, a catchword-like line "simpli-" at the foot right of the text box.

main_text.p: nis quoque viris, pio zelo præ-ditis, summa quasi religionis in huiusmodi reliquijs con-quirendis, auro & gemmis ex-ornandis, & memorijs, seu templis sumptuosissimis ædi-ficandis posita putaretur: & ab improbis quoque hominibus, falsa fiducia in cultu in-epto & superfluo reliquiarum collocaretur: Quare in Con-cilio Cabilonensi reprehen-duntur qui Romam, aut Tu-ronum sub prætextu orationis peragrant, putantes frequen-tatione horum locorum se a peccatis purgari, & impunè peccare: Accesserunt & alia mala; quòd auaritiæ causâ ad simpli-

page.notes: The catchword "simpli-" is a hyphenated word continued on the next page, printed at the foot right of the text block. Ornamental top rule and running head are as printed. Some faint show-through from the reverse side is present and omitted.
